finalText:
**The build is green again.**

One real error hid under the noise: `src/core/settings.js` read a bare `retries`, which never existed. That threw `ReferenceError: retries is not defined` and killed the link step.

It now reads `env.retries` and falls back to a new `DEFAULT_RETRIES = 2`.

Build finishes with 0 errors, exit 0.

The 3 warnings are still there and are separate work:

| Code | Where |
| --- | --- |
| `W1042` deprecated `crypto.createCipher` | `src/legacy/adapter.js` |
| `W2213` unused export `formatLegacyDate` | `src/utils/format.js` |
| `W3307` circular import | `src/core/graph.js` ↔ `src/state/tracker.js` |

Those files aren't in this project yet, so I left them alone.
